blocks.text: while loop tab tak chalta rehta hai jab tak condition (shart) True ho. Har iteration (loop ka ek chakkar) se pehle condition check hoti hai, aur condition False hote hi loop ruk jata hai.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
Yeh while loop ki shakal (syntax) hai, poora program nahi.
"while": keyword, chhote letters mein.
"condition": yahan apni shart likhein; har chakkar (iteration) se pehle check hoti hai.
":": shart ke baad colon zaroori.
"# code to run while the condition is true": yahan woh indented code aata hai jo shart True rehne tak baar baar chale.
Is block mein koi aisi line zaroor honi chahiye jo aakhir kaar shart ko False kar de, warna loop kabhi nahi rukega (infinite loop). Sirf comment rakhne par IndentationError aata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab ke syntax mein "while condition:" pehli comment line ke aakhir mein chhap gaya hai. Asal shakal oopar hai: while condition: aur us ke neeche indented code.
Misaal: number mein 1 jorte jayein jab tak woh 10 tak na pohanche.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"number = 1": shuru ki value 1.
"while number < 10:": har chakkar se pehle check: number 10 se kam hai?
"print(number)": number ki maujooda value print hoti hai.
"number += 1": number mein 1 jur jata hai (number = number + 1). Yahi line loop ko aakhir kaar rokti hai; isay hata dein to loop kabhi khatam nahi hoga.
Jab number 10 ho jata hai to 10 < 10 False hai aur loop ruk jata hai; 10 print nahi hota.
Output: 1 se 9 tak numbers, har ek alag line mein.
Khud try karein: number = 5 kar ke Run karein: ab sirf 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 print honge.

blocks.alt: Flowchart: number = 1, phir sawal number < 10?. True ho to print(number), phir number += 1, aur baen taraf ki lakeer wapas sawal par le jati hai. False ho to daen taraf Loop khatam (1 se 9 print ho chuke).

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: while loop se Python program likhein jo 1 se 20 tak even (juft) numbers print kare aur odd (taaq) numbers count kare (gine).

blocks.prompt: Class activity: 1 se 20 tak even numbers print karein aur odd numbers ginein.
blocks.explanation: n = 1; count = 0; while n <= 20: (andar) if n % 2 == 0: print(n) else: count += 1; phir n += 1. Loop ke baad print("Odd numbers:", count). Yeh 2, 4, ..., 20 print karta hai aur 10 odd numbers ginta hai.

blocks.prompt: while loop likhein jo 1 se 20 tak odd (taaq) numbers print kare aur gine (long question 6; class activity).
blocks.explanation: n = 1; count = 0; while n <= 20: if n % 2 == 1: print(n); count += 1 (if ke andar); n += 1 (loop ke andar); aakhir mein print("Total odd numbers:", count), jo 10 print karta hai.

blocks.text: Yeh while loop 1 se limit tak numbers jorta hai aur har iteration (chakkar) mein total dikhata hai. limit badal kar Run karein aur dekhein loop kitni baar chalta hai.

limit = 5
number, total = 1, 0
while number <= limit:
    total += number
    print("number =", number, " total =", total)
    number += 1
print("1 se", limit, "tak ka sum =", total)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"limit = 5": kahan tak jorna hai.
"number, total = 1, 0": number 1 se shuru, total (kul jor) 0 se.
"while number <= limit:": jab tak number 5 ya kam hai loop chalta hai.
"total += number": har chakkar mein number total mein jur jata hai: 1, 3, 6, 10, 15.
"print("number =", number, " total =", total)": har chakkar ki halat dikhata hai; " total =" ke shuru wale space aur comma ke space ki wajah se beech mein do spaces aate hain.
"number += 1": agla number; 6 hone par shart False aur loop khatam.
"print("1 se", limit, "tak ka sum =", total)": loop ke baad (indented nahi) sirf ek baar chalti hai.
Output: "number = 1  total = 1" se "number = 5  total = 15" tak paanch lines, phir "1 se 5 tak ka sum = 15".
Khud try karein: limit = 10 kar ke Run karein: loop 10 baar chalega aur aakhri line "1 se 10 tak ka sum = 55" hogi.

items: while: condition True rehne tak dohrata hai; number += 1 na ho to loop kabhi na ruke.
Misaal 1 se 9 tak print karti hai.
